subject: UefiPayloadPkg: Fix build failure with CLANGPDB
reasons: The same enum-member replacement is repeated across multiple call sites in one file.
The before/after mapping is explicit: switch `EfiPciWidthUint32` to `EfiPciIoWidthUint32`.
This is a small but clean API/enum migration pattern that Coccinelle handles well.
candidate_pattern: Replace `EfiPciWidthUint32` with `EfiPciIoWidthUint32` in repeated `PciIo->Pci.Read()` and `PciIo->Pci.Write()` call sites.
